newsitem.title: USA: Arris confirms positive finds on APC-366.
newsitem.headline: Arris confirms positive finds on APC-366.

text.p: Arris Pharmaceutical Corp said Wednesday that a pilot study confirms earlier findings that its tryptase inhibitor, APC-366, may help asthma patients.

The study demonstrated that subjects who got a low dosage of APC-366 got a 42 percent degree of protection, while those who got a higher dose exhibited a 62 percent degree of protection, the company said.
Arris said it has begun recruiting patients at Guys Drug Research Unit in London to continue studying APC-366.
